Observed_Phenomenon: MultiScale-895p and Distilled Student-421p both report exact PA-F1 = 0.8643 despite disparate Raw-F1 (0.3455 vs 0.3102)
Mathematical_Diagnosis: Point-Adjustment Saturation: Point-adjustment assigns 100% true-positive credit to an entire anomaly segment as long as at least 1 window is flagged. The distilled student triggered >=1 hit in the exact same ground-truth segments as the MultiScale model, causing the PA-F1 formula to saturate at 0.8643 while true point-wise accuracy was 10.2% lower (0.3102 vs 0.3455).
Referee_Ruling: Validates the core thesis finding on Point-Adjustment inflation: PA-F1 masks point-wise precision degradation.
